title: 2026-10-28 英文軌：詞塊與跟讀
description: 間隔複習、短文、5 個詞塊（signal a policy shift、cut back on ad spending 等）、1 個句型與輸出練習。英文為美式發音。
queue: 這裡是今天的英文練習。開車請專心，你只需要用耳朵聽，再開口跟著念。
第一段，間隔複習。這五個是你之前學過的詞塊。我先說中文，停四秒，請你說出英文，然後我再念答案。
The more A, the more B
第二段，今天的短文。先聽一次，再聽中文意思，最後慢速再聽一次。

On Wednesday, the Fed is expected to hold rates steady, but investors will look past the headline and listen for any signal of a policy shift. In marketing, many big brands now spend less on ads as a share of sales, even though their budgets have grown. And a small study on phone use suggests that self-control may matter more than hours, because every app is competing for attention.
中文意思。星期三，聯準會預期會維持利率不變，但投資人會看透標題，留意任何政策轉向的訊號。在行銷領域，許多大品牌現在花在廣告上的錢，占營收的比重變小了，雖然他們的預算其實在增加。另外，一項關於手機使用的小型研究顯示，自制力可能比時數更重要，因為每個 App 都在爭奪注意力。

On Wednesday, the Fed is expected to hold rates steady, but investors will look past the headline and listen for any signal of a policy shift. In marketing, many big brands now spend less on ads as a share of sales, even though their budgets have grown. And a small study on phone use suggests that self-control may matter more than hours, because every app is competing for attention.
第三段，今天的五個詞塊。每一個，我會念詞塊，說中文，念例句，說例句的意思，再慢速念一次，然後停三秒，請你跟著念。
意思是，釋出政策轉向的訊號。
A single remark from the chair can signal a policy shift.
意思是，主席的一句話，就可能釋出政策轉向的訊號。
A single remark from the chair can signal a policy shift.
When sales slow, some brands cut back on ad spending first.
意思是，銷售放緩時，有些品牌會先縮減廣告支出。
When sales slow, some brands cut back on ad spending first.
Ad spending fell as a share of sales, even though the budget grew.
意思是，雖然預算增加了，廣告支出占營收的比重卻下降了。
Ad spending fell as a share of sales, even though the budget grew.
Every app on your phone is competing for your attention.
意思是，你手機裡的每個 App，都在爭奪你的注意力。
Every app on your phone is competing for your attention.
Many people struggle with self-control late at night.
意思是，許多人在深夜很難克制自己。
Many people struggle with self-control late at night.
A may look like B, but it is really C
意思是，A 看起來像 B，其實是 C。
A falling ratio may look like a budget cut, but it is really a sign of faster sales growth.
意思是，比例下降看起來像是預算被砍，其實是營收成長更快的跡象。
A falling ratio may look like a budget cut, but it is really a sign of faster sales growth.
第五段，輪到你。請用這個句型，在心裡說一句關於你上一堂課的英文。停八秒。
A quiet class may look like a focused class, but it is really a tired one.
意思是，安靜的班級看起來像專注的班級，其實是疲憊的班級。
今天的五個詞塊，會在明天、三天後、七天後，再出現一次。
